reviewer: Codex local implementation/self-review; not independent approval

criteria.scope: 150 unchanged reference checkpoints / 300 workflow states; 30 selected configurations, all 45 text / 63 integrated selected captures, keyboard navigation and visible focus/state cues
Fixed/fill/content measure/arrange, cycle/depth/finite/realization limits, separate invalidation and cached semantics, 64 MiB temporary-paint pressure rejection
Stale geometry, moved/removed capture, modifier release, modal retirement, composition commit/cancel and queue reset policies
Hierarchy/roles/names/values/state/actions, virtual row navigation and notifications; byte-identical full model checkpoints for keyboard and semantic workflow
Missing resources, invalid geometry and pressure preserve accepted model state and reject honestly

limits: Hosted core only; no guest execution, isolation or ISO change
No native IME, UI Automation, screen reader or full Unicode/font coverage
No file-driven reload or performance/retention acceptance; P2-11/P2-12 remain open
Full redraw, full-surface group copies and allocator-wide OOM limits remain; 64 MiB temporary bound is not process or guest accounting
Native replay injects modeled input into real presented Windows frames; automatic DPI/device-driver acceptance remains open
visual_review: Selected standard 150 percent and high-contrast 200 percent PNGs inspected locally; original comparison design retained, with geometric focus, checked mark and list selection bar. No multilingual/accessibility expert approval.
